observations: The original troll, Footman and Orc Warrior unit sheets share controlled dark contours, grouped painted shading, earthy materials and clear silhouettes. Goblin concept B follows this treatment. Wolf Scout and mage modeling masters simplify shading for extraction; their smoother human/anime faces should not control the troll. Use the original troll sheet for species and the Footman sheet for rendering and human palette.

references.role: PRIMARY SPECIES: the supplied three woodland trolls. Long wedge-like drooping nose, tiny amber eyes, coarse dark hanging hair and beard, lumpy grey anatomy, trinkets and turquoise markings. No visible ears.
EDIT BASE: keep full-body standing hulking posture, smaller human-relative scale, club, framing and shoulder ruins. Replace the human-like face and fleshy skin.
USER-APPROVED FEATURE: preserve these two broken cottage wall clusters, snapped timber, moss and their natural integration across back and shoulders.

RENDERING ONLY: game-native painted modelling, controlled dark contours, earthy warm highlights/cool shadows, readable material shapes. Also blue-and-cream human scale figures; never copy human facial anatomy onto the troll.

acceptance: No visible ears, ear stumps, holes or earrings.
Face clearly belongs to supplied troll species rather than a human elder.
Stone surfaces visible across face, limbs and torso.
Approved broken house fragments retained across shoulders and back.
Standing hulking posture and reduced scale remain.
Game-native contours, painted material planes and restrained earthy colour.
